blocks.text: The Miss Universe Vietnam organization has withdrawn the title of its 2026 winner, Nguyen Quynh Anh, citing violations of the conditions of her previous suspension. The pageant organization initially suspended Nguyen from participating in activities using her title, following allegations that she made offensive comments about her fellow beauty queens and individuals associated with the pageant. In a statement released on Wednesday, Nov. 18, Five6 Entertainment, the production company behind the Miss Universe Vietnam 2026, said the beauty queen continued attending events despite her suspension without informing the organization.
